title: Fair Domain Generalization: An Information-Theoretic View

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Equal Opportunity (EO) and Equalized Odds (EOD) violations based on Total-Variation distance in multi-class facial attribute classification tasks across intersecting groups of perceived age and gender (e.g., male-young, female-old) using the CelebA dataset.
Measuring EO and EOD violations in facial expression classification tasks across different perceived racial groups (White, Black, East Asian, Indian) under domain shifts using the AffectNet dataset.

Measuring EO and EOD violations in text toxicity classification tasks across comments containing different gender-related terms (male, female, transgender) under domain shifts using the Jigsaw dataset.
